name: McCloud generation facility (El Paso Electric / Wurldwide-Meta)
description: 366 MW net peak from 813 modular 450 kW gas generators on 31 acres adjacent to the Meta data centre in northeast El Paso County; 225 MW continuous at ~95% load factor during bridge period; EPE owns, Enchanted Rock engineers/procures/constructs/operates/maintains; no RFP or cost-benefit analysis was conducted.

milestones.event: Application filed to amend certificate of convenience and necessity for 366 MW McCloud facility

capex.metric: total estimated cost of McCloud generation facilities
capex.basis: PUC Proposal for Decision Finding of Fact 17: approximately $499.8m comprising $473m cash construction cost (including 10% contingency) plus $26.8m allowance for funds used during construction. Generation only; excludes transmission interconnection.
PUC filing, generation facilities only; Meta bears all costs during a bridge period of up to five years

capex.metric: allowance for funds used during construction
EPE capital cost estimate including interconnection and AFUDC
capex.basis: PUC record citing City of El Paso witness Scott Norwood; also stated as $1,609/kW. PFD does not reconcile this with the $499.8m figure.
EPE estimate, 20-year service life; intervenors compare against generic combustion turbine

capex.metric: generic combustion turbine capital cost, EPE 2025 IRP
capex.basis: City witness Norwood Table 3; longer 30-year life, lower fixed O&M and lower heat rate than McCloud. EPE argues IRP values are outdated.

capex.metric: recently approved Entergy Texas gas plants, capital cost per kW
capex.basis: EPE cites Docket 56693 Order on Rehearing (9 Dec 2025) to argue McCloud compares favourably
Intervenor cost comparison; generic combustion turbine fixed O&M is $24/kW-year
PUC record; EPE existing Rio Grande Unit 9 and Montana Power Station units estimated at $26.75/MWh
PUC record; generic combustion turbine heat rate 10,564 Btu/kWh
